bias.en: Bearish, improving · SAR turns bullish, above the 10-day
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · SAR 转多，站上 10 日均线

read.en: Intel rose 3.6% on Oct 27 to $93.74, trading between $91.86 and $94.98. It is above the falling 5-day ($89.9) and 10-day ($91.7) and the rising 200-day ($86.3), and below the falling 30-day ($106.8) and 100-day ($105.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Oct 27 ($84.65), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月27日上涨 3.6%，收于 $93.74，盘中区间 $91.86–94.98。股价位于下行的 5 日（$89.9）和 10 日均线（$91.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$86.3）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$106.8）和 100 日均线（$105.5）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 10月27日转为看多（$84.65），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The close cleared $92.1–92.7 (Oct 26 high, 10-day, old SAR), now support, and the high passed $94.4 (Oct 21 high) before stopping under $95.4. Resistance is $95–95.4 (Oct 27 and 19 highs), then $97.7–98.2 (Oct 13–14 lows) and $101.3 (Oct 14 high). Support is $91.7–92.1, then $88.8–89.9 (Oct 20 low, 5-day) and $86.3 (200-day). A close above $95.4 would target $98; below $91.7, $89.

s.en: 10-day average $91.7; Oct 27 low $91.9; Oct 26 high $92.1, cleared
